basis: Whole direct electricity-infrastructure operation/planning candidate under existing criterion. Complete own EH and selected dated service/public-utility/organization/bulk-power baselines, not a full current integrated-law certificate.
critical_boundaries: Discretionary order powers follow complaint/finding/notice/hearing; no universal plant/fuel mandate
Prohibited generating-facility enlargement and impaired-service sales remain; compensation and cost allocation mandatory determinations
Distinct projected-adequacy, order, extension and notice clocks; no automatic extension
Environmental shield covers compliance-necessary acts/omissions including voluntary compliance, not unconditional immunity
Five-year public notices for covered at-least5MW bulk-power-interconnected units; unplanned inoperability exception; no automatic retirement ban
